You’ll be responsible for keeping our Material Handling Equipment running at peak performance, solving malfunctions independently, and implementing improvements. Your insight and initiative are valued, and you’ll coach junior colleagues to elevate the team, ensuring tens of thousands of orders reach families on time every day. During your shift, you take full responsibility for the service and maintenance of our systems. The tricks of the trade Troubleshooting malfunctions: You detect and resolve both electrical and mechanical issues in technical systems, working closely with our operational supervisors. Collaboration with suppliers: For complex problems, you work directly with machine suppliers to find solutions. Analysis and improvement: You analyze malfunctions, prevent recurrence, and implement structural improvements. Preventive maintenance: You perform scheduled preventive maintenance to ensure maximum system availability. About you You hold a Ausbildung and/or a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a technical field (e.g., mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, mechatronics, automation, etc.) You have 7+ years of experience in a technical or maintenance role You have hands-on knowledge of electrical and mechanical systems, including measurement and camera systems You have been working with software tools such as CMMS and/or ICS/SCADA tools You have strong communication skills and enjoy collaborating in a team At the same time, you are independent, take initiative, and solve problems in a goal-oriented way You're fluent in English and/or German What you can look forward to Smart Commute: Choose the way you move. You will get a company car (with private use) and can make use of our “Lease-a-Bike” program. Time to recharge: With 30 days of vacation per year (based on a 40-hour workweek in a shift system), you can strike the perfect balance between work and leisure. Fuel for Winners: Enjoy fresh, free breakfasts and lunches every day in our Fulfilment Center, along with all the snacks and fruit you need to stay fueled. Kickstart your career: Join our international team in an environment that fosters real growth and an “Act like an Owner” mentality. Here, you’ll have the chance to drive projects independently, test new ideas, and level up through specialized Lepaya trainings to see firsthand how your work makes an impact. Sustainability at Core: Be part of the revolution. You’ll contribute to a greener future through our 100% electric fleet and a business model designed to drastically reduce food waste. The Essentials: We provide the tools for success, including a laptop and phone, and access to exclusive Corporate Benefits discounts for travel, tech and more. Unforgettable Moments: From our legendary annual ski trip, our massive Christmas parties, to parties featuring our very own Picnic band, we make sure our milestones are celebrated in style. Well-being & Balance: Professional mental health support via OpenUp.
